basic_details.job_title: ESIC Recruitment 2026 – Walkin for 37 Senior Resident, Specialist Posts
basic_details.short_information: ESIC Hospital, Sonagiri, Bhopal-462022 (M.P) will hold a walk-in interview on 4 December 2026 for doctors, with reporting at the Administration Office on the hospital's ground floor from 9:15 AM to 11:00 AM. Under Advertisement No 04/2026 of the Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC), the hospital will fill 19 contractual Senior Resident posts (3-year tenure) and 18 Full Time/Part Time Contractual Specialist posts. Senior Residents and Full Time Specialists get pay level 11 with a basic pay of Rs 67,700 plus allowances, and Part Time Specialists get Rs 60,000 per month.

age_limit.details: For both posts, age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/PWD/Ex-serviceman candidates will be applicable as per DOPT rules. Candidates claiming EWS reservation must submit the EWS certificate prescribed in DoPT OM No. 36039/1/2019-Estt. (Res) dated 31-01-2019, and those claiming OBC reservation or relaxation must submit the OBC certificate prescribed in DoPT OM No. 36012/22/93-Estt.(SCT) dated 08/09/1993, as modified, or the latest Government of India notification. | Only candidates who hold the relevant qualification and registration on the date of interview will be considered; those whose result is awaited will not be considered. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

Full Time Specialists are engaged for 3 years, with annual evaluation and the term renewed every year on satisfactory performance. Part Time Specialists are engaged for 1 year from the date of joining or till a regular incumbent joins. Full Time Specialists get leave at 04 days for each month of work on a pro-rata basis in a calendar year; unused leave may be encashed up to 30 days a year. Part Time Specialists are not entitled to any leave. Private practice of any kind is not allowed, except for Part Time Specialists.

important_instructions: Selected candidates must sign a contract agreement on a Non-Judicial Stamp Paper of Rs. 500 before joining, at their own cost. Contractual Specialists and Senior Residents must deposit a security of Rs. 10,000 by Demand Draft in favour of ESI Fund A/c. No.1, Bhopal at joining, refundable after the contract on production of a "No dues certificate". Selected candidates must have a professional indemnity policy with a minimum sum assured per annum of 30 lakhs for Anesthesiologists, Rs. 20 lakhs for General Surgeons, ENT, Eye, Orthopedics, OBGY etc., and 10 lakhs for General Medicine, Dentists, Radiologists, Pathologists etc. A copy must be submitted within 7 days of engagement. The Contractual Specialist will be responsible for all cases under treatment under his supervision in his discipline. Appointment is subject to medical fitness; selected Specialists must submit a written acceptance/consent letter before the medical examination. The engagement may be terminated by either side with one month's notice without assigning a reason; selected candidates have no claim to regularisation. If reserved category candidates are not available, the vacancy may be filled for less than 45 days as a de-reserved seat. The Medical Superintendent reserves the right to alter the date, cancel the interview, or vary or cancel any of the posts. Any change will be intimated only on www.esic.gov.in.

content_sections.heading: About ESIC Bhopal
content_sections.text: ESIC Hospital, Sonagiri is a hospital of the Employees' State Insurance Corporation in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh. The recruitment is conducted by the Medical Superintendent, ESIC Hospital, Sonagiri, Bhopal, who is also the controlling authority for the Full Time and Part Time Contractual Specialists. Senior Residents are engaged under the Central Residency Scheme.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: The 37 posts are spread over 15 departments, as printed in the notice: The reservation for Persons with Benchmark Disability (PWD) will follow the prevailing Government of India guidelines, and PwBD reservation may be interchanged with other PwBD categories as per Government of India/DoPT guidelines. The notice says the number of vacancies and category-wise vacancies may vary or are likely to increase or decrease. Qualification: MBBS with PG Degree/PG Diploma in the required discipline from a recognized university, OR MBBS with 2 years working experience in the same discipline (not from a private clinic). Age: not exceeding 45 (Forty Five) years as on the date of interview. Engagement: on contract initially for one year, extendable up to 03 (three) years under the Central Residency Scheme. Candidates who have already worked as SR for 03 years after PG Degree/Diploma under the Central Residency scheme in any Govt. organization are not eligible. Applicants must give an undertaking regarding Government hospital residency compliance. Qualification: MBBS and PG Degree with concerned/broad specialty, as the case may be, with three years work experience, OR Diploma with five years work experience in concerned/broad specialty, as the case may be. Registration: the candidate must be registered with the Medical Council of India or a State Medical Council. Age: not exceeding 67 years as on the date of interview. For Casualty (Accident & Emergency Dept.), preference will be given to postgraduates having PG in Critical care. Preference will be given to Full Time Specialists; if none is available, a Part Time Specialist of the respective category will be appointed. For both posts, age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/PWD/Ex-serviceman candidates will be applicable as per DOPT rules. Candidates claiming EWS reservation must submit the EWS certificate prescribed in DoPT OM No. 36039/1/2019-Estt. (Res) dated 31-01-2019, and those claiming OBC reservation or relaxation must submit the OBC certificate prescribed in DoPT OM No. 36012/22/93-Estt.(SCT) dated 08/09/1993, as modified, or the latest Government of India notification. Only candidates who hold the relevant qualification and registration on the date of interview will be considered; those whose result is awaited will not be considered. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post. Full Time Specialist pay is as per HQ Office Memorandum dated 08.12.2022 and later ESIC instructions. Part Time Specialist: Rs 60,000 per month for a four-hour session per day for four days a week, plus Rs 15,000 per month on giving an undertaking to be available for emergency call duty after scheduled timings. Work above 16 hours a week earns Rs 800 per hour, subject to approval of the MS. Full Time Specialists are engaged for 3 years, with annual evaluation and the term renewed every year on satisfactory performance. Part Time Specialists are engaged for 1 year from the date of joi

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Application form in the prescribed format of Annexure-A, filled in block letters, with a recent attested passport size photograph pasted. Original certificates for age proof (date of birth), educational qualification, Medical Council Registration of the State/MCI, experience certificates and caste certificate (as applicable). One set of self-attested copies covering age, qualifications, attempt certificate, mark-sheet, degree, MCI or State registration, EWS/SC/ST/OBC/PWD/Ex-serviceman certificate and experience certificate. 2 recent passport size colour photographs. NOC from the employer, preferably, for candidates working in Govt./Autonomous/Statutory/Private institutions, or a copy of "applied for NOC". The checklist in Annexure-A names: date of birth certificate; degree certificate with attempt certificate; diploma certificate with attempt certificate (if applicable); experience certificate (if applicable); MCI/State Medical Council registration; and caste (SC/ST/OBC/EWS), PWD and Ex-servicemen certificates, if applicable. A separate application must be submitted for each post.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Report at the Administration Office, Ground Floor, ESIC Hospital, Sonagiri, Bhopal between 9:15 AM and 11:00 AM with the documents. Applications are scrutinised and documents verified the same day; no candidate is allowed for document verification after 11:15 AM. Only candidates whose documents are verified and who are found eligible are allowed to attend the walk-in interview. If vacancies remain unfilled after 4 December 2026, interviews will be conducted on the second Wednesday of the month, and candidates should watch www.esic.gov.in for the status of unfilled vacancies. No TA/DA will be paid for attending.

faq.question: Q1. When is the ESIC Bhopal walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for Senior Resident and Specialist posts is on 4 December 2026 at ESIC Hospital, Sonagiri, Bhopal.

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time and venue?
faq.answer: Candidates must report at the Administration Office, Ground Floor, ESIC Hospital, Sonagiri, Bhopal from 9:15 AM to 11:00 AM; those reporting after 11:15 AM will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are there?
faq.answer: There are 37 vacancies: 19 Senior Resident posts and 18 Full Time/Part Time Contractual Specialist posts across 15 departments.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for Senior Resident?
faq.answer: MBBS with PG Degree/PG Diploma in the required discipline from a recognized university, or MBBS with 2 years working experience in the same discipline (not from a private clinic).

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for Specialist?
faq.answer: MBBS and PG Degree in the concerned/broad specialty with three years work experience, or Diploma with five years work experience, along with registration with the Medical Council of India or a State Medical Council.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Senior Resident: not exceeding 45 years; Specialist: not exceeding 67 years, both as on the date of interview, with relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/PWD/Ex-serviceman as per DOPT rules.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary?
faq.answer: Senior Residents and Full Time Specialists get entry pay level 11 with basic pay of Rs 67,700; Part Time Specialists get Rs 60,000 per month for four-hour sessions four days a week.

faq.question: Q8. Are allowances paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: Senior Residents and Full Time Specialists get other allowances as admissible in ESIC; Part Time Specialists get Rs 15,000 per month for an emergency call duty undertaking and Rs 800 per hour above 16 hours a week.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Applications and documents are verified on the interview day, and only candidates found eligible are allowed to attend the walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply for both posts?
faq.answer: The notice says an application should be submitted for each post separately, using the Annexure-A form.
